# MarkDoc Test Fixtures

This directory contains synthetic documents used across unit, integration, and performance tests (QR-7.1, QR-4.2).

## Documents

- `gfm-full.md` — exercises all supported GFM constructs
- `headings-only.md` — simple heading hierarchy for outline tests
- `mermaid-valid.md` — valid Mermaid diagrams
- `mermaid-invalid.md` — intentionally broken Mermaid syntax
- `with-frontmatter.md` — YAML front matter sample
- `with-images.md` — relative image references
- `broken-image.md` — intentionally broken image path
- `with-style-sidecar.markdoc-style.json` — style override sidecar

## Performance corpus (QR-4.2)

Generated by `tests/fixtures/generate-large-docs.ts`:

- `perf-standard.md` (~10k words)
- `perf-large.md` (~50k words)
- `perf-very-large.md` (~150k words)
